theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :

  · intro x hx
    -- `x` upper-bounds `f '' S`, hence also its closure
    have hx' : x ∈ upperBounds (closure (f '' S) : Set α) := by
      simpa using (by

    -- then `x` upper-bounds the range, since `range f ⊆ closure (f '' S)`
